author: Life of Boris
description:
finding out how much weight can yeast dough really lift. it's a lot.
weights spanning from 5 grams to 3 kilograms.

the recipe I use:
500ml warm water (slightly warmer than hand temp)
500ml wheat flour
11g dry active yeast
5tbsp white sugar
1tsp salt
1tsp vanilla sugar
